coordinateSystem.origin: ground plane below midpoint between axles
coordinateSystem.positions: GLB model coordinates; node local positions are relative to parentNode

usage.doorControl: Play the component openClip/closeClip once with looping disabled, or rotate its node around the stated local axis. Do not play open and close simultaneously.
usage.annotationControl: Use the annotation node world position to follow the animated component. position is the closed-pose model-space fallback; localPosition follows parentNode.
usage.animationTiming: Each independent clip is 1.2 seconds, sampled at 30 fps. Open starts closed; close starts open. Hold the last frame.
usage.wheelControl: Wheel and brake nodes are separate. Rotate wheel nodes around spinAxis; keep brake nodes stationary during wheel spin.
usage.interface: No application or PlayCanvas interface files are included or modified.
